input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements obligation on Client. The licence grant in Section 2(a) is expressly non-exclusive and affirmatively confirms that Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink" (subject only to TrueLink's IP and Client's confidentiality obligations, which are ordinary carve-outs, not restraints on sourcing). A full-text sweep for "exclusive", "sole", "compet" and third-party procurement language turned up nothing binding Client: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink only a non-exclusive licence to Credit Data (and the referenced Non-Competition Agreement operates as a limitation on TrueLink, i.e. in our favour), and the only other "exclusive" usage is the exclusive-forum provision in Section 12. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
